title: Show discrete samples as a stem plot

actions.text:
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3))  # create the figure and set its size
plt.stem(t, x)  # draw vertical lines for discrete samples
plt.title("Same signal drawn with stem")  # state what the figure shows
plt.xlabel("Time (s)")  # label the horizontal axis and its unit
plt.ylabel("Amplitude")  # label the vertical axis and its unit
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)  # add a grid so values are easy to read
plt.tight_layout()  # keep labels from being clipped
plt.show()  # render and show the figure

clips.caption: stem draws each <c.aqua>sample</c.aqua> as a vertical line, which suits a <c.aqua>discrete signal</c.aqua> better. Same values, different drawing, more accurate meaning.
